message: `watch` created inside a repeating watcher callback is not stopped when that callback ends
help: Keep the inner stop handle, register it with `onCleanup` / `onWatcherCleanup`, or re-enter an owner `scope.run` (outer 6:1, source 7:9). The first immediate run may be scope-owned; later callbacks still leak.
